src: EIA Drilling Productivity Report, 'RegionCounties' sheet of https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/drilling/xls/dpr-data.xlsx (Permian, Eagle Ford and Haynesville regions, Texas rows; regions are 'delineated along county lines', see https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/drilling/pdf/dpr_methodology.pdf; file last modified Mon, 13 May 2024 11:47:15 GMT) and Railroad Commission of Texas 'Major Oil and Gas Formations' pages, section 'Affected Counties': https://www.rrc.texas.gov/oil-and-gas/major-oil-and-gas-formations/permian-basin/; https://www.rrc.texas.gov/oil-and-gas/major-oil-and-gas-formations/eagle-ford-shale/; https://www.rrc.texas.gov/oil-and-gas/major-oil-and-gas-formations/haynesville-bossier-shale/; https://www.rrc.texas.gov/oil-and-gas/major-oil-and-gas-formations/barnett-shale/. Barnett has no EIA region, so its list is the RRC's.

basins.name: Permian Basin
basins.note: Primary list: EIA Drilling Productivity Report 'Permian Region' (51 Texas counties; the region also has 4 NM counties outside Texas, not shown). RRC's page lists 61 counties (field `rrc`). Counties in only one of the two lists are ambiguous (field `ambiguous`): EIA only: none; RRC only: Brewster, Cottle, El Paso, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis, King, McCulloch, Presidio, Runnels, Stonewall. EIA delineates its regions along county lines, not geology, so fringe counties on the shelves and plateau edges are included.

basins.name: Eagle Ford
basins.note: Primary list: EIA Drilling Productivity Report 'Eagle Ford Region' (23 Texas counties; no counties outside Texas). RRC's page lists 27 counties (field `rrc`). Counties in only one of the two lists are ambiguous (field `ambiguous`): EIA only: none; RRC only: Grimes, Robertson, Walker, Washington.

basins.name: Haynesville (East Texas)
basins.note: Primary list: EIA Drilling Productivity Report 'Haynesville Region' (13 Texas counties; the region also has 2 AR, 10 LA counties outside Texas, not shown). RRC's page lists 10 counties (field `rrc`). Counties in only one of the two lists are ambiguous (field `ambiguous`): EIA only: Cherokee, Smith, Upshur; RRC only: none.

basins.name: Barnett
basins.note: Primary list: RRC 'Barnett Shale Information & Statistics' page, Affected Counties (25; the field is Newark, East (Barnett Shale)). The page says the play covers 'at least 18 counties' but lists 25 without marking which are core, so treat the edge counties of the list as ambiguous. EIA's Drilling Productivity Report has no Barnett region.
